session.assistantText:
Goal restated: have a reviewer who did not write the code look over the file I changed and flag redundant comments, report only, no code edits.

This capability exists here. The bundled `no-comments` skill plus the `comment-sicko` agent preset are installed under the pstack package, so I can spawn a fresh comment reviewer as a subagent. The one file changed in the workspace is [README.md](README.md) (untracked, no commits yet).
The dedicated capability exists in this environment, so no fallback was needed.

How it ran: the bundled pstack `no-comments` skill is installed under the package, and the `comment-sicko` agent preset is available, so I spawned a fresh reviewer that had not written the code, scoped to the changed file, told to report only.

Scope was the only file in the workspace, [README.md](README.md) (untracked, `main` has no commits).

Reviewer result, measured from reading the file:
- Deletions: 0
- MUST KILL flags: none
- Skips: none

The file is 3 lines: a heading, a blank line, and one prose line. It has no code comments, no lint or TypeScript suppressions, no doc blocks, no banners, no commented-out code, and no HTML comments.

One caveat the reviewer raised: it read "comments" strictly as code and Markdown HTML comments, so prose lines themselves were out of its kill list. If you want headings and prose judged as deletable filler too, that is a different scope and I would rerun with that instruction. No code was changed.
session.userText: 在评审前，让一个没参与写这段代码的审查者过一遍我改的文件，指出多余的注释，只报告、不改代码。这个专项审查能力在这个环境没有的话就说明并给替代流程。
